result.changelog: Fixed all 3 errors. (1) Corrected who wanted the Sanctuary Fortress detour: the Dark Pirate Troopers were trying to force Samus onto it, and Dark Samus killed them. (2) Phaaze was located by Aurora Unit 217, not found aboard the Valhalla. (3) Only Gandrayda vowed to bring Samus's helmet. Noncanon: removed the NTSC-only Pirate Data account of the Pirates capturing Metroid Prime and losing containment. Softened the claim that a Metroid absorbed the Leviathan core, and dropped the uncited claim that losing the suit freed Samus of corruption. Unverified items: checked each one and replaced 'months of corruption' with the one-month coma. Rewrote the Aurora virus line: the Federation believed it was of Pirate origin and it disabled the Units, with no link to Dark Samus. Kept the 'last gesture' (Metroid Wiki Samus Aran page), the fleet losing contact (Wikipedia) and the Phazon-blue visor (Corruption page). Dropped the 'brief skirmish' and the SkyTown name; the mourning is now placed on Elysia. Nits: battle count set to three, Norion generators and the Rundas rescue corrected, hunter deaths reordered, the 'her own Phazon' pronoun fixed, and weaknesses corrected (only the pure-Phazon form is Phazon-only). The second Echoes battle is now placed on the approach to the Aerie. Added that the other hunters woke weeks earlier. Keys: removed the aliases shared with the SA-X (doppelganger, evil Samus, dark twin and similar). Secondary keys are now Dark Samus aliases only, plus Aurora Unit 313 on the return entry; Phazon, Space Pirates and corruption were dropped from them. No key appears in both lists of the same entry, Metroid Prime is now a gated primary key, and missing forms were added (regeneration, teleportation, weaknesses, Leviathan Seeds). Trimmed sub-entries from 468-504 words to 398-406; the overview is 456. Kept 6 entries with the same titles.
result.unresolved: The Prime-to-Dark-Samus origin is confirmed only by the Japanese Echoes website Q&A, labelled inline 'per the official Japanese website'. Sylux following Samus comes from the conditional ending; it is kept because Prime 4 continues it. The location of the second Echoes battle is unclear: Metroid Wiki gives both 'Aerie Transport Elevator/Station' and 'Aerie Access', so the entry says 'on the way to the Aerie'. The Phazon purge from Samus's body is stated on the Dark Samus page but not on the Corruption plot page, so it is kept per the Dark Samus page. WebSearch was not used. The file was written by a Python build script (scratchpad/build_dark_samus.py) rather than the Write tool. Four sub-entries run 1-6 words over 400 because of their See-also lists.
